tools.name: list_platform_tools
tools.description: List tool NAMES for a platform - NO PARAMETER SCHEMAS! Returns simple list of tool names and what they do. If you need details, call get_tool_schema(tool_name) next.

returns.description: List of tool names and descriptions only (no parameters)

tools.name: get_tool_schema
tools.description: Get FULL parameter schema for ONE specific tool. Use this AFTER list_platform_tools() to learn how to use a tool before executing it.

returns.description: Complete tool schema with parameters, types, descriptions, examples

tools.name: search_tools
tools.description: Search for tools by keyword or task. Examples: search_tools('email') finds all email tools, search_tools('gmail') finds Gmail tools, search_tools('create document') finds document creation tools.

returns.description: Matching tools with names and descriptions (no parameters)

tools.name: execute_tool
tools.description:
PROXY FUNCTION: Execute ANY discovered tool by name. After discovering tools via list_platform_tools(), use this to execute them.

Workflow:
1. Call list_platform_tools('google_workspace')
2. See gmail_send_email with parameters: to, subject, body
3. Call execute_tool('gmail_send_email', to='john@example.com', subject='Hello', body='Test')

This allows dynamic tool execution without sending all 603 tool schemas upfront.

tool_name.description: Name of the tool to execute (e.g., 'gmail_send_email', 'google_docs_create_document')

returns.description: Result from the executed tool with success/failure and data
